Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other vehicle was changing lanes, reporting
pain and swelling in the right knee. Over the course of 24 office visits, care consisted of physical examination,
imaging review, a structured physical therapy program, and activity modification with anti-inflammatory medication as
needed. Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as symptoms improved and range of motion returned.
Several examination findings, including joint line tenderness and effusion at initial evaluation, are consistent with the
reported injury, while certain ligament stability tests and neurovascular checks were within normal limits. At this time it
remains unclear whteher the knee injury is directly attributable to the collision, and further records would be needed to
settle that question. The patient reports no prior injury to the same area of the knee. Billing records reflect single,
non-duplicated charges for each service rendered.
</page>

Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
